documents.title: Corporate Action Book Closure From Friday July 31,2026 To Thursday August 06,2026
Corporate Action: Record Date For Payment Of Dividend 2025-26
Compliance-57 (5) : intimation after the end of quarter

analysis.summary: Crestchem Limited reported a total income of Rs. 25.52 Crores and a net profit of Rs. 2.71 Crores for the financial year 2025-26. The company declared a final dividend of 15% and remains entirely debt-free. To drive long-term growth, Crestchem incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited as a subsidiary to set up a Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil manufacturing facility in Bengaluru.

guidance.claim: Commercial production of the MCT Oil project is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.
guidance.quote: Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.

guidance.claim: The company stated that it is difficult to project a business outlook due to continued international disturbances.
guidance.quote: The implication of such continued disturbances is difficult to predict and hence it is difficult to project an outlook.

guidance.claim: The company mentioned that it may not be possible to provide a business outlook for the company and the industry in general at this point in time.
guidance.quote: As such it may not be possible at this point of time to provide business out look for our Company and Industry in general.

guidance.claim: The company believes its financial position will improve considerably in the coming years.
guidance.quote: The company is committed to build the business operations within budget and considering that the business operates on a going concern basis, it is believed that financial position of the company will improve very considerably in the coming years, going by the recent last few years improvement in performances as well.

guidance.claim: The company expects it will take a few more years of sustained growth to generate adequate high profits.
guidance.quote: There is a continuous substantial improvement in the performance of the Company; however, it will take few more years for sustained growth before the Company can generate adequate high profits.

demand_outlook.claim: The global and Indian MCT market is experiencing healthy growth due to rising consumer awareness of preventive healthcare, ketogenic diets, sports nutrition, and functional foods.
demand_outlook.quote: The global and Indian MCT market continues to witness healthy growth due to increasing consumer awareness regarding preventive healthcare, ketogenic diets, sports nutrition and functional foods.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for MCT Oil is rising, driven by health consciousness, clinical and functional nutrition, and premium specialty ingredients.
demand_outlook.quote: The global demand for MCT Oil continues to grow, driven by increasing health consciousness, expanding applications in clinical and functional nutrition, and rising demand for premium specialty ingredients.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is reasonably optimistic but notes that predicting market demand and trends is difficult due to critical economic conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: Management is reasonably optimistic however, it is difficult to predict the market demand and its trend, due to critical economic conditions created by disturbances due to Covid-19, Ukraine war etc.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that opportunities exist in the growing field of specialty chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: Opportunities are already there in the field of specialty chemicals, which is a growing field, in which the company operates.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to face price volatilities.
demand_outlook.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

demand_outlook.claim: The company notes that it is difficult to predict market demand and trends due to critical economic conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: Management is reasonably optimistic however, it is difficult to predict the market demand and its trend, due to critical economic conditions created by disturbances due to Covid -19, Ukraine war etc.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited as a subsidiary to set up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its long-term growth strategy, the Company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited, Bengaluru, as its subsidiary with an equity participation of 75% for setting up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil, a high-value specialty product catering to pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and personal care industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Procurement and installation of plant, machinery, utilities, and other equipment for the project are currently underway.
capex_expansion.quote: The procurement and installation of plant and machinery, utilities and other equipment for the project are presently in progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively planning to expand and invest in new or startup businesses in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms within specialty chemicals and related fields.
capex_expansion.quote: As was reported in previous financial year’s Annual Report the Company is now actively planning to expand and invest in new/start up business in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms, within our Speciallity Chemicals and related fields of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to establish a pilot plant facility for these products at the LLP firms in due course.
capex_expansion.quote: Accordingly, requisite pilot plant facility, for such products, is likely to be established by our company at such LLP firms, in due Course.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest in new or start-up limited liability partnership firms within its chemical and related operations.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is planning to invest in new/start up business- limited liability partnership firm(s), within our overall chemical and related field of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is hopeful of establishing a pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.
capex_expansion.quote: Company is hopeful for pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.

margins_costs.claim: The company faces threats from volatility in the prices of coconut oil and palm kernel oil.
margins_costs.quote: Volatility in prices of coconut oil and palm kernel oil.

margins_costs.claim: Supply chain disruptions and freight cost fluctuations pose threats to the company.
margins_costs.quote: Supply chain disruptions and freight cost fluctuations.

margins_costs.claim: The company focused on improving turnover, which ultimately resulted in improved profitability.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has focused to improve the turnover and ultimately it resulted to improve the profitability of the Company.

margins_costs.claim: The company is mitigating risks through superior cost-effective technologies.
margins_costs.quote: But we are mitigating the risks byway of superior cost-effective technologies.

margins_costs.claim: The company monitors employee costs as a key area of cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The company endeavors on cost effective initiatives including employee cost, being one of the key areas of cost monitoring and control, the results of any structural initiatives needs to be measured over a long term horizon and cannot be strictly compared only with annual performance indicators.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently implementing small to medium-sized mandates.
orders_capacity.quote: At present, the Company is implementing small to medium size mandates and accordingly, the profits too are moderate.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is working on building a track record to qualify for large-sized mandates.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company is still in the process of gaining experience and building a track record that would qualify the Company to implement large size mandates.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is debt-free and has no borrowings from any bank or institution.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has no borrowings from any Bank or any Institution.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a 15% dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors pleased to inform that Company has declared 15%Dividend for the year 2025-26 (Subject to TDS as per Income tax Act) subject to approval of members at ensuing Annual General Meeting.

capital_allocation.quote: Your directors are pleased to inform that Company has declared 10% ( Rs.1/- per Share) Dividend for the year 2024-25 (Subject to TDS as per Income tax Act) subject to approval of members at ensuing Annual General Meeting.

capital_allocation.quote: The Company has transferred the above profit amount under the head reserves and surplus and stakeholders net worth of the Company has been increased and that will help the stake holders for value maximization in periods to come.

capital_allocation.quote: ALF invoice of BSE dated 12-04-2025 of Rs. 3,25,000/- +Rs. 58,500/- GST, totaling to Rs 3,83,500/- has been paid on 16-04-2025 vide Bhuj Mercantile Co-op bank Limited by UTR :HDFCR52025041661374981 dated 16-04-2025 well within the stipulated time period, of due date.

capital_allocation.quote: While filing reclassification of share from promote group category to public category BSE has issued various previous SOP under various regulation of LODR and the company has made payment of RS. 357540/- to BSE on 05-03-25 vide UTR : INDBR32025030500948930, as previous years penalty raised by BSE for various late filing.

capital_allocation.quote: Your directors pleased to inform that Company has declared 5% Maiden Dividend for the year 2023-24 (Subject to TDS as per Income tax Act) subject to approval of members at ensuing Annual General Meeting.
